gaps.sentence: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
gaps.explanation: would rather + somebody + past simple: I'd rather you didn't smoke.

gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: The rules don't ___ visitors to touch the paintings.
gaps.explanation: allow + object + to-infinitive: allow visitors to touch. (let + bare: let visitors touch.)

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
They made me ___ for the whole team's mistake.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive in active sentences: made me apologise.

gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
